Playbook.name: Defender — Endpoint Incident Spanning Multiple Attack Tactics - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: Defender alerts on one host span multiple ATT&CK tactics (ES|QL) - a multi-stage attack chain on a single endpoint. Triage: a real multi-stage intrusion, or unrelated alerts coinciding on a busy host?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: A host with alerts across multiple tactics is progressing through an attack chain - a confirmed-compromise pattern.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Defender XDR alerts via Elastic Agent (verified live). Fields: m365_defender.alert.detection_source, .severity, .status, .title, .category, threat.tactic.name, user.name, host.name, m365_defender.alert.evidence.device_dns_name. INGEST LAG ~26 min - 4h windows + event.ingested override.

Signal.Name: Endpoint Incident Spanning Multiple Atta
Signal.Details: host with Defender alerts spanning multiple tactics.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the multi-tactic alerts form a real attack chain on the host or are coincidental.

Step.name: Tactics and alerts on the host
Step.Purpose: The sequence of tactics shows whether this is a coherent kill chain.
Step.Query: FROM logs-m365_defender.alert* | WHERE host.name == "$host" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, threat.tactic.name, m365_defender.alert.title, m365_defender.alert.severity | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 25
Step.AnalystNotes: A progression (Execution -> Credential Access -> Lateral Movement -> Exfiltration) on one host in a short window = a real intrusion. Unrelated low-severity alerts spread over time are coincidental.

Node.Condition: A coherent multi-tactic kill chain on the host in a short window.
Unrelated, mostly low-severity alerts coinciding on a busy host.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-DEFMULTI-TACTICS to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: Coincidental unrelated alerts on a busy host.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm each benign; close as false_positive.
Isolate the host; open IR; reconstruct the chain from the Defender timeline; hunt peers.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Isolate the host; reconstruct the chain from the Defender timeline.
Open IR for a confirmed multi-stage intrusion.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Isolate + IR; reconstruct the kill chain; hunt peers.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Ensure Defender enforcing; integrate the Defender timeline into IR.

QualityChecks.Check: Multi-tactic correlation on host.name; Defender ingest lag ~26 min.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Intrusion chain reconstructed and contained; peers hunted.
